strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of website-builder/SaaS company Wix.com, backing early-stage startups (pre-seed/seed) at the intersection of online design and development, commerce and business management, and AI/automation; portfolio companies gain strategic support and access to Wix's platform and expertise.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the Wix Ventures website; the arm also runs the Wix Ventures Innovation Hub / Foundry program.

summary.en: Wix Ventures (launched in 2020 as 'Wix Capital') is the corporate venture arm of Tel Aviv-based website-building and SaaS company Wix.com. It invests in pre-seed and early-stage software/technology startups worldwide that sit at the intersection of online design/development, commerce/business management, and AI/automation, with check sizes ranging from hundreds of thousands to a few million dollars.
summary.local: ויקס ונצ'רס היא זרוע ההשקעות התאגידית של חברת ויקס (Wix.com) מתל אביב, המשקיעה בסטארטאפים בשלבים מוקדמים בתחומי SaaS, מסחר מקוון, פינטק ו-AI.

strategy.thesis: Global corporate venture fund of identity-security vendor CyberArk, backing early-stage cybersecurity startups across network, application and data security; offers go-to-market support, access to CyberArk technology and CyberArk Labs research, and engagement with CyberArk leadership.

people.name: Udi Mokady
people.role: CyberArk Founder / Executive Chairman (CEO at launch)

application.how_to_apply: Inbound via CyberArk Ventures website; investments typically alongside CyberArk's strategic VC partners.

summary.en: CyberArk Ventures is the $30 million global corporate venture fund of CyberArk, the Israeli/US identity-security company (headquartered in Petah Tikva, Israel and Newton, Massachusetts). Launched in May 2022, it backs early-stage cybersecurity startups across network, application and data security, alongside strategic VC partners Venrock, YL Ventures, Team8 Capital and Merlin Ventures.
summary.local: סייברארק ונצ'רס היא קרן ההון-סיכון התאגידית של חברת אבטחת הזהויות סייברארק (במטה בפתח תקווה), בהיקף 30 מיליון דולר, המשקיעה בסטארטאפים בתחום הסייבר.

sources.title: CyberArk Ventures Launches with $30 Million Fund to Fuel Innovative Cybersecurity Technologies
sources.supports: Launch May 2022, $30M fund size, cybersecurity focus, strategic VC partners, initial portfolio (Dig Security, Enso Security, Zero Networks), CyberArk HQ (Newton MA + Petah Tikva Israel)
sources.quote: CyberArk Ventures ... a $30 million global investment fund designed to empower the next generation of disruptors solving complex security challenges. ... Our first three investments are the trifecta – network security, application security and data security.

verification_notes: Fund size ($30M) and launch (May 2022) from CyberArk's official press release. CyberArk is dual-headquartered (Petah Tikva, Israel and Newton, Massachusetts); listed as an 'Israeli Corporate VC' on Start-Up Nation Finder. Two initial portfolio companies (Dig Security, Enso Security) have since been acquired by third parties. Check size and updated portfolio count not disclosed.

strategy.thesis: Thesis-led corporate venture arm of telecom/media software company Amdocs; goes deep in defined focus areas (communications/media, AI/ML acceleration, cybersecurity, virtual care) and works for its portfolio companies post-investment to provide access to target customers, product scale and de-risked go-to-market.

application.how_to_apply: Inbound via Amdocs Ventures website; thesis-led so engagement is typically within Amdocs' defined focus areas.

summary.en: Amdocs Ventures is the corporate venture arm of Amdocs, the Israeli-founded telecom and media software company (Ventures team based in Ra'anana, Israel). Founded around 2018, it is a thesis-led investor in communications/media, AI/ML, cybersecurity and digital-health startups, and works actively for portfolio companies on customer access and go-to-market. Listed on Start-Up Nation Finder as an 'Israeli Corporate VC.'
summary.local: אמדוקס ונצ'רס היא זרוע ההון-סיכון התאגידית של חברת התוכנה אמדוקס (צוות ההשקעות ברעננה), המשקיעה בסטארטאפים בתחומי תקשורת ומדיה, AI, סייבר ובריאות דיגיטלית.

strategy.thesis: Growth-stage corporate investment arm of mobile-games leader Playtika; first fund is Israel-focused and targets profitable / near-breakeven digital-entertainment and consumer-internet companies (typically $10M+ revenue), giving portfolio companies access to Playtika's marketing, monetization, analytics, technology and product teams.

application.how_to_apply: Direct outreach to Playtika Growth Investments; targets later-stage Israeli digital-entertainment / consumer-internet companies.

summary.en: Playtika Growth Investments is the growth-stage corporate investment arm of Herzliya-based mobile-games company Playtika, announced in 2018. Its first, Israel-focused fund plans to invest up to $400 million in profitable or near-breakeven digital-entertainment and consumer-internet businesses (typically $10M+ in revenue), with portfolio companies gaining access to Playtika's marketing, monetization, analytics, technology and product expertise.
summary.local: פלייטיקה גרות' אינבסטמנטס היא זרוע ההשקעות הצמיחה התאגידית של חברת המשחקים פלייטיקה (הרצליה), עם קרן ראשונה ממוקדת ישראל בהיקף של עד 400 מיליון דולר לחברות בידור דיגיטלי ואינטרנט צרכני.

sources.supports: Fund size up to $400M, Israel-focus, growth stage / $10M+ revenue targets, Herzliya HQ, leadership (Robert Antokol CEO, Eric Rapps MD)
sources.quote: Playtika Growth Investments ... First Fund Will Be Israel-focused and Plans to Invest Up to $400 Million With Portfolio Companies Gaining Access to Playtika Operational Teams

verification_notes: Fund size (up to $400M) and Israel focus are from Playtika's official 2018 launch press release. The '$400 million' is a planned/ceiling figure for the first fund, not confirmed deployed capital. Listed on Start-Up Nation Finder as an Israeli Corporate VC. Specific portfolio companies and current deployment not disclosed in primary sources reviewed; this arm operates more as a growth-equity / strategic-investment vehicle than a classic early-stage CVC.
